fields.description_zh:
訪員：請依據樣本資料卡，把個案108年調查婚姻狀況填入後，再問A1。

Interviewer: Based on the sample data card, enter the case's marital status from the 2019 survey, then ask A1. 
A0 [Interviewer check] Based on the sample data card, check the case's marital status from the previous (2019) survey

fields.description_zh: A1_108 請問四年前（108年），您是否仍有先生/太太（或伴侶）？
fields.description_en: A1_108 Four years ago (2019/ROC 108), did you still have a husband/wife (or partner)?

fields.description_zh: A1_1 若108年調查婚姻狀況為有偶，這次調查時（目前）婚姻狀況？
fields.description_en: A1_1 If marital status in the 2019 (ROC 108) survey was married, what is the marital status at this survey (currently)?

fields.description_zh: A1_2 若108年調查婚姻狀況為無偶，這次調查時（目前）婚姻狀況？
fields.description_en: A1_2 If marital status in the 2019 (ROC 108) survey was no spouse, what is the marital status at this survey (currently)?

fields.description_zh:
A1a 【近四年內喪偶者請問】您的先生/太太（或伴侶）是什麼時候過世的？
1 民國_______年（應在108年或108年之後）
fields.description_en:
A1a [For those widowed within the past four years] When did your husband/wife (or partner) pass away?
1 ROC year _______ (should be ROC 108 or later)
2_______months

fields.description_zh:
A1b 【近四年內離婚或分居者請問】您們是什麼時候離婚或分居的？
1 民國_______年（應在108年或108年之後）
fields.description_en:
A1b [For those divorced or separated within the past four years] When did you divorce or separate?
1 ROC year _______ (should be ROC 108 or later)
2_______months

fields.description_zh: A2 【108年及目前均有另一半（先生/太太，或伴侶）者，請問】您和您現在的先生/太太（或伴侶）已經結婚（在一起）多久了？（是否有超過四年以上？）
fields.description_en: A2 [For those who had a partner (husband/wife or partner) both in 2019/ROC 108 and currently] How long have you and your current husband/wife (or partner) been married (together)? (Has it been more than four years?)

fields.description_zh: A2a 您先生/太太（或伴侶）是否經常與您住在一起？
fields.description_en: A2a Does your husband/wife (or partner) usually live with you?

fields.description_zh: A2b 為什麼他/她沒有經常住在這裡？
fields.description_en: A2b Why doesn't he/she usually live here?

fields.description_zh: A2c 請問您們多久見一次面？
fields.description_en: A2c How often do you see each other?

fields.description_zh: A2d 請問您先生/太太（或伴侶）目前的健康情形好不好？
fields.description_en: A2d How is your husband's/wife's (or partner's) current health?

fields.description_zh:
A2e. 【訪員查核】
1:已經問過A1a或A1b題(何時過世、離婚或分居)，請跳問A5題
0:沒有問過A1a或A1b題的，請續問A2f題
fields.description_en:
A2e. [Interviewer check]
1: Question A1a or A1b (when deceased, divorced, or separated) has already been asked -- skip to A5
0: Question A1a or A1b has not been asked -- continue to A2f

fields.description_zh: A2f 【結婚（或在一起）不到四年請問】那是因為原來的先生/太太（或伴侶）去世或因為離婚（或正式分居或分手），才再結婚（或在一起）的呢？
fields.description_en: A2f [For those married (or together) less than four years] Was it because your previous husband/wife (or partner) passed away, or because of divorce (or formal separation or breakup), that you remarried (got together again)?

fields.description_zh:
A3 【近四年內喪偶者請問】您的先生/太太（或伴侶）是什麼時候過世的？
1 民國_______年（應在108年或108年之後）
fields.description_en:
A3 [For those widowed within the past four years] When did your husband/wife (or partner) pass away?
1 ROC year _______ (should be ROC 108 or later)
2_______months

fields.description_zh: A4 【近四年內離婚者請問】請問您與上一任先生/太太（或伴侶）是什麼時候離婚（或分手）的？民國_______年_______月離婚（或分手）的 （應在108年或108年之後） 1 民國年
fields.description_en: A4 [For those divorced within the past four years] When did you divorce (or break up with) your previous husband/wife (or partner)? Divorced (or broke up) in ROC year _______ month _______ (should be ROC 108 or later) 1 ROC year
2_______months

fields.description_zh: A5 您最近這一次是什麼時候結婚（或在一起）的？民國_______年_______月結婚的（或在一起的）（應在108年或108年之後） 1 民國_______年
fields.description_en: A5 When did you most recently get married (or get together)? Married (or got together) in ROC year _______ month _______ (should be ROC 108 or later) 1 ROC year _______
2_______months

fields.description_zh: A6 您先生/太太（或伴侶）是否經常有與您住在一起？
fields.description_en: A6 Does your husband/wife (or partner) usually live with you?

fields.description_zh: A6a 為什麼他/她沒有經常住在這裡？
fields.description_en: A6a Why doesn't he/she usually live here?

fields.description_zh: A6b 請問您們多久見面一次？
fields.description_en: A6b How often do you meet?

fields.description_zh: A7 請問您先生/太太（或伴侶）是哪一年出生的？或現在幾歲？
fields.description_en: A7 What year was your husband/wife (or partner) born? Or how old are they now?

fields.description_zh: A7_1 是哪一年出生的？
fields.description_en: A7_1 What year were they born?

fields.description_zh: A7_2 現在幾歲？
fields.description_en: A7_2 How old are they now?

fields.description_zh: A8 他/她是本省閩南人、本省客家人、外省人或原住民？還是哪裡人？
fields.description_en: A8 Is he/she Taiwanese Hoklo (Minnan), Taiwanese Hakka, Mainlander, or Indigenous? Or where is he/she from?

fields.description_zh: A9 他/她的最高學歷（接受最高的學校教育）是甚麼？教育程度代號：
fields.description_en: A9 What is his/her highest education level (highest level of schooling received)? Education level code:

fields.description_zh:
A9a. 【訪員查核】：
1:教育程度代號有選06，09，12，14，16的任一項
0:教育程度代號沒有選06，09，12，14，16的任一項【跳問A10】
fields.description_en:
A9a. [Interviewer check]:
1: Education level code selected is one of 06, 09, 12, 14, 16
0: Education level code selected is none of 06, 09, 12, 14, 16 [Skip to A10]

fields.description_zh: A9b 他/她的最高學歷是已畢業或是肄業？
fields.description_en: A9b Did he/she graduate from, or drop out of, his/her highest level of education?

fields.description_zh: A10 請問您先生/太太（或伴侶）目前的健康情形好不好？
fields.description_en: A10 How is your husband's/wife's (or partner's) current health?

fields.description_zh: A11 請問您平常有固定住在某個地方嗎？或者您是在幾個子女家裡輪流住？
fields.description_en: A11 Do you usually live in one fixed place, or do you rotate among several of your children's homes?

fields.description_zh: A12 ★請問您喜不喜歡現在住的這個房子？是很喜歡、喜歡、普通、不太喜歡或很不喜歡？
fields.description_en: A12 ★Do you like the house you currently live in? Would you say you like it very much, like it, feel neutral, don't like it much, or dislike it a lot?

fields.description_zh: A13 請問您住在這個房子已經多久了？有沒有超過四年？【若為輪住者，自開始輪住於此迄今，是否已有四年以上】
fields.description_en: A13 How long have you lived in this house? Has it been more than four years? [For those who rotate residences, has it been four years or more since you started rotating to live here?]

fields.description_zh: A13a 最近四年裡，您是否曾搬去別處住（四個月以上）又搬回？【輪住者若離開此處小於四個月者，視同長住沒有搬出】
fields.description_en: A13a In the past four years, did you ever move elsewhere to live (for more than four months) and then move back? [For those who rotate residences, if they left this place for less than four months, this is treated as long-term residence with no move-out]

fields.description_zh: A14 請問您最近一次是從什麼地方搬到這裡來住？是從附近或是較遠的其他地方？
fields.description_en: A14 Where did you move here from most recently? Was it from nearby or from somewhere farther away?

fields.description_zh:
A14a 您為什麼要搬到這裡住呢？  
(1) 結婚
fields.description_en:
A14a Why did you move here to live? 
(1) Marriage

fields.description_zh: (2) 分家
fields.description_en: (2) Family separation (splitting household)

fields.description_zh: (3) 自己或配偶更換工作
fields.description_en: (3) Self or spouse changed jobs

fields.description_zh: (4) 變賣土地或結束生意
fields.description_en: (4) Sold land or closed a business

fields.description_zh: (5) 配偶或其他親人死亡
fields.description_en: (5) Spouse or other relative died

fields.description_zh: (6) 年齡太大或健康因素，不能工作/獨自料理家務
fields.description_en: (6) Too old or health reasons, unable to work/manage household alone

fields.description_zh: (7) 與以前同住的人相處不好
fields.description_en: (7) Didn't get along with previous cohabitants

fields.description_zh: (8) 方便子女就學
fields.description_en: (8) Convenient for children's schooling

fields.description_zh: (9) 跟隨子女搬家
fields.description_en: (9) Moved to follow children

fields.description_zh: (10) 子女需要您的幫忙
fields.description_en: (10) Children need your help

fields.description_zh: (11) 子女希望您和他/她一起住
fields.description_en: (11) Children want you to live with them

fields.description_zh: (12) 換/買房子
fields.description_en: (12) Change/buy a house

fields.description_zh: (13) 經安排輪住
fields.description_en: (13) Arranged to live in rotation among family members

fields.description_zh: (14) 因經濟發生問題，而必須搬到這裡住
fields.description_en: (14) Had to move here due to financial problems
(15) Other

fields.description_zh: B．家戶結構、親屬概況及互訪
fields.description_en: B. Household structure, relatives overview, and mutual visits

fields.description_zh:
B1 請問您現在有幾個親生的兒子及女兒【目前存活子女數】？不管他們是不是跟您住在一起，都算。 您目前有沒有養子或養女、繼子或繼女？
a.親生兒子
fields.description_en:
B1 How many biological sons and daughters do you currently have [number of currently living children]? Count them regardless of whether they live with you or not. Do you currently have any adopted sons or daughters, or stepsons or stepdaughters?
a. Biological sons

fields.description_zh: b.親生女兒
fields.description_en: b. Biological daughter

fields.description_zh: c.養（繼）子
fields.description_en: c. Adopted/step son

fields.description_zh: d.養（繼）女
fields.description_en: d. Adopted/step daughter

fields.description_zh:

fields.description_en:

1: Currently has children

fields.description_zh: B2 請問在您現有的這些子女中，與您經常同住在這戶內的有幾人？沒有經常與您同住的有幾人？ 1 同住子女數
fields.description_en: B2 Of your current children, how many regularly live with you in this household? How many do not regularly live with you? 1. Number of co-residing children

fields.description_zh: C45a 請問您有沒有接種過新冠肺炎的疫苗？接種過幾劑（包含加強劑、追加劑）疫苗？【疫苗定義：任何新冠疫苗都算，不限台灣施打】
fields.description_en: C45a Have you been vaccinated against COVID-19? How many doses (including booster/additional doses) have you received? [Vaccine definition: any COVID-19 vaccine counts, not limited to those administered in Taiwan]

fields.description_zh: C45a_1 接種過幾劑（包含加強劑、追加劑）疫苗？【疫苗定義：任何新冠疫苗都算，不限台灣施打】 ＿＿＿劑
fields.description_en: C45a_1 How many doses (including booster/additional doses) have you received? [Vaccine definition: any COVID-19 vaccine counts, not limited to those administered in Taiwan] ＿＿＿ doses

fields.description_zh: C45b 請問您是否曾經過醫師確認，確診罹患新冠肺炎？ 【確診定義：（1）經醫院或診所PCR、抗原快篩檢驗為陽性；（2）家用PCR、抗原快篩檢驗為陽性，並經醫師確認（視訊問診、面對面診療都算）】
fields.description_en: C45b Have you ever been confirmed by a doctor to have contracted COVID-19? [Confirmed case definition: (1) tested positive by PCR or rapid antigen test at a hospital or clinic; (2) tested positive by an at-home PCR or rapid antigen test and confirmed by a doctor (both telemedicine and in-person consultations count)]

fields.description_zh: C45b_1 請問您第一次確診是在什麼時候？
fields.description_en: C45b_1 When was your first confirmed diagnosis?

fields.description_zh:

 a 沒有這種情形
fields.description_en:
C45b_2 One month after your first confirmed diagnosis, what symptoms persisted for a long time without improving? [Multiple choice except option a]
a No such symptoms

fields.description_en: e. Chronic cough

fields.description_zh: i 落髮

fields.description_en: c. In-home rehabilitation professional service

a No

fields.description_en: C49 Do you currently wear glasses (including reading glasses or contact lenses)?

fields.description_en: C49a Do you have difficulty seeing things?

fields.description_en: C51 Do you have difficulty with memory or feel unable to concentrate?

fields.description_zh: C51a 當您使用慣用的語言與別人溝通時，是否會有困難，例如：您了解別人說的或別人也了解您說的？
fields.description_en: C51a When communicating with others in your usual language, do you have difficulty, for example understanding what others say or having others understand what you say?

fields.description_zh:
C52 過去一年中，請問您有沒有在日常生活中用一些方法來預防或控制慢性疾病？ 【先讓個案自己說有用哪些方法來預防或控制慢性疾病，個案沒提到的部分再探問】
1.控制體重
fields.description_en:
C52 In the past year, have you used any methods in daily life to prevent or control chronic disease? [Let the respondent first say which methods they use to prevent or control chronic disease on their own; probe for parts not mentioned]
1. Weight control

fields.description_zh: 2.少抽菸或戒菸
fields.description_en: 2. Smoke less or quit smoking

fields.description_zh: 3.少飲酒或戒酒
fields.description_en: 3. Drink less alcohol or quit drinking

fields.description_zh: 4.養成運動的習慣
fields.description_en: 4. Develop the habit of exercising

fields.description_zh: 5.飲食控制（多吃纖維、均衡飲食等）
fields.description_en: 5. Diet control (eat more fiber, balanced diet, etc.)

fields.description_zh: 6.生活規律、避免熬夜、放鬆壓力等生活調適
fields.description_en: 6. Regular routine, avoiding staying up late, relaxing/reducing stress, and other lifestyle adjustments

fields.description_zh: 7.遵醫囑、按時吃藥、量血壓
fields.description_en: 7. Follow doctor's orders, take medication on time, measure blood pressure

fields.description_zh: 8.其他方法
fields.description_en: 8. Other methods

fields.description_en: C53 [Interviewer check]

fields.description_zh:
C54 ★當今社會，有些人會有一些精神上的壓力或煩惱，但有些人不會。下面我會提一些問題，請您告訴我，這些問題有沒有給您帶來壓力或煩惱？ 【若有】是有一些壓力或煩惱，還是有中等程度的壓力或煩惱，或有很大的壓力或煩惱？ 【加問】除了這些外，還有沒有什麼讓您有壓力或煩惱的？
1 自己的健康
fields.description_en:

[If yes] is it a little stress or worry, a moderate amount, or a great deal? [Additional question] Besides these, is there anything else causing you stress or worry?
1 Your own health

fields.description_zh: C55 ★如果0分代表「一點也不滿意」，10分代表「非常滿意」，整體而言，您對於目前生活的滿意程度，從0分到10分之間，您會給幾分?

1 不太想吃東西，胃口很差

fields.description_en: 2 Feel that everything is an effort

fields.description_zh: 4 覺得心情很不好

Now I want to ask some questions about you helping family members, other relatives, or friends.

fields.description_en: D1. Do you currently help take care of your grandchildren or help others take care of children? [If yes] Is it often or occasionally? [Child refers to those in high school or below]

Bathing, eating, dressing, personal grooming, getting in/out of bed, using the toilet, or moving around indoors?

fields.description_zh: D2 您目前是否有在幫忙或督導沒有辦法自行處理生活起居的家人、親戚或朋友做下列任何事情，例如： 2 b.購買雜貨用品、準備三餐、洗衣服、作家事、管理金錢、吃藥或是打電話？
fields.description_en: D2. Are you currently helping or supervising a family member, relative, or friend who cannot manage daily activities on their own, with any of the following, for example: 2 b. Shopping for groceries, preparing meals, doing laundry, housework, managing money, taking medication, or making phone calls?

fields.description_zh: D3 【訪員查核】：
fields.description_en: D3. [Interviewer check]:

fields.description_zh: D4 ★當您需要和人談您的問題或您的心事時，您覺得您的家人、親戚或朋友，願不願意聽您講？是很願意、願意、普通、不太願意，還是很不願意？
fields.description_en: D4. * When you need to talk to someone about your problems or personal concerns, do you feel your family, relatives, or friends are willing to listen? Very willing, willing, neutral, somewhat unwilling, or very unwilling?

fields.description_zh: D5 ★您覺得您的家人、親戚或朋友，是不是關心您？是很關心、關心、普通、不太關心，還是很不關心？
fields.description_en: D5. * Do you feel your family, relatives, or friends care about you? Very much, somewhat, neutral, not very much, or not at all?

fields.description_en: D6. * In general, are you satisfied with the degree of care (emotional/psychological) your family or relatives/friends show you? Very satisfied, satisfied, neutral, not very satisfied, or very dissatisfied?

G．經濟狀況 
接下來，我們想請教您一些您的經濟和財務狀況。問您這方面的問題，純粹只是為了瞭解我國中年人與老年人的經濟狀況。您的資料會與其他接受我們訪問的長者的情形，合起來做統計，而且純供研究之用，我們也絕對負責保密。所以請您儘可能將您的實際情況告訴我，以免分析出來的結果不正確。

G6 ★整體而言，您對您目前的經濟狀況滿不滿意？
G7 ★跟四年前比起來，您覺得您目前的經濟狀況是比較好或比較差？

G10 ★【請將下圖指給個案看：】 這裡有一個樓梯，從下到上總共有十階。 這個樓梯代表在臺灣的每一個人所擁有的地位。最高的一階是代表在臺灣條件最好的人，最低的一階是代表在臺灣條件最差的人。 您站在這梯子的愈上層就愈接近地位高的人，您站在這梯子的愈下層就愈接近地位低的人。和所有臺灣的人比較，以您自己目前的情形來看，您認為您自己應該是在這個樓梯的那一階？請您指給我看。
fields.description_en: G10 ★ [Please point to the figure below for the respondent:] Here is a ladder with ten steps from bottom to top. This ladder represents the status held by every person in Taiwan. The top step represents people with the best circumstances in Taiwan, and the bottom step represents people with the worst circumstances. The higher you stand on this ladder, the closer you are to high status; the lower you stand, the closer you are to low status. Compared to everyone in Taiwan, based on your current situation, which step do you think you should be standing on? Please point it out to me.
